name: Migrate the Opal website (WordPress) to AWS -- TARGET: opalinvest.com
description: *** READ FIRST -- DOMAIN CORRECTION 2026-07-13 (Andrew-direct, SOVEREIGN): THE TARGET IS opalinvest.com. Everything below that says or implies opalcapital.com was written under a MISTAKEN PREMISE -- Opal DOES NOT OWN opalcapital.com ('thats on me... we need to not be using that'). It is purged; its SES identity is deleted. Note also opalinvest.DEV is Andrew's TEMPORARY DASHBOARD url, NOT the website. The 'opalcapital.zip' backup FILENAME below is historical fact and is fine; every DOMAIN/DNS/cutover statement below is SUPERSEDED by the 'phase' + 'blocking' fields. *** ORIGINAL (2026-07-01): Andrew-direct. Lift-and-shift the Opal marketing website into the Opal AWS estate; keep GoDaddy as the DNS/registrar (records-only cutover, no zone move). GROUNDED against two provided backups (updraft backup.zip = UpdraftPlus set 2026-06-30; opalcapital.zip = full tree + 16MB opal_202606.sql): WordPress built with Bricks builder (bricks + bricks-opal child + AutomaticCSS); 16MB DB, ~13MB media, 18 plugins (gravityforms/omnisend/wp-mail-smtp/litespeed-cache/redirection/seopress/pdf-embedder/safe-svg/ACPT + security wps-hide-login/wps-limit-login/password-protected/turnstile + updraftplus/migrate-guru). Small low-traffic corporate site. TARGET (recommended): EC2 in the Opal VPC (Terraform-managed), OpenLiteSpeed+PHP8+MariaDB-local (16MB DB doesn't warrant RDS), Elastic IP (GoDaddy apex A-record -> EIP = the clean keep-GoDaddy path), Let's Encrypt/Certbot TLS, UpdraftPlus->S3 backups, SG-locked + SSM. Alternatives documented: Lightsail (simpler, off-VPC), EC2+RDS (overkill for 16MB), EC2+CloudFront+ACM (GoDaddy-apex-ALIAS nuance). Static-export REJECTED (Gravity Forms + dynamic backend). Migration: Terraform provision -> WP stack -> UpdraftPlus restore -> re-activate licenses (Bricks/ACSS/GravityForms/Omnisend) -> configure -> STAGE+CVO-verify -> lower TTL -> GoDaddy record cutover -> Certbot -> post-verify -> rollback-window (old host stays live). ~$20-40/mo. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_WEBSITE_PRD.md.
phase: *** DOMAIN CORRECTED 2026-07-13 (Andrew-direct, SOVEREIGN). TARGET IS opalinvest.com, NOT opalcapital.com. *** VERBATIM: 'it needs to be opalinvest.com. I thought Patricia said opalcapital.com, that we were switching to this URL from opalinvest.com, but that was incorrect. We need to build around opalinvest.com' + 'We do not even own opalcapital.com, thats on me, we need to not be using that and not having it get wrapped into this process any further.' + 'opalinvest.dev is my temporary url for the dashboard, the official website is opalinvest.com'. ACTIONS TAKEN (0.7.0_AE_CloudOps, 2026-07-13): the opalcapital.com SES DOMAIN IDENTITY WAS DELETED (we had asserted send-authority for a domain Opal does not own; its DKIM had already gone FAILED because the CNAMEs were never added -- so nothing shipped and nothing needed undoing); opalcapital.com purged from all website code/config/docs (tls-cutover.sh, tls-prep.sh, ses-sendmail.sh, bootstrap-stack.sh, create-wp-admin.sh, iam.tf, RUNBOOK, READMEs, SES case draft). W1 (platform) = COMPLETE + closed. W2 (SES SMTP via instance-role shim, TLS prep, DLM backups) = COMPLETE. THE SITE IS MIGRATED AND SERVING the real Bricks content on the box (i-0152e3fe2599fa630, EIP 18.208.18.213). REMAINING = the cutover, re-planned on the CORRECT domain with STAGING FIRST (Andrew-chosen 2026-07-13): PHASE A = GoDaddy adds 'A new -> 18.208.18.213', re-key WP off the raw IP, HTTP-01 cert for new.opalinvest.com, review the real site on real HTTPS (Wix + apex + email ALL untouched); PHASE B = re-key to the apex, lower the apex TTL 24-48h ahead, DNS-01 cert for apex+www (HTTP-01 CANNOT work -- the apex still resolves to Wix), strict-verify + SAN-assert, THEN flip the apex A + www, then convert-renewal (a --manual cert never auto-renews). Driven end-to-end by infra/aws/ec2/website/tls-cutover.sh (fails closed).
blocking: CRITICAL PATH = GODADDY DNS ACCESS FOR opalinvest.com, WHICH ANDREW DOES NOT HOLD -- CFO AJ GRAFF DOES. Nothing else blocks. The single unblocking action is ONE additive record: 'A / new -> 18.208.18.213' (TTL 600). It cannot affect the live site and cannot affect email. *** TWO HAZARDS THAT DID NOT EXIST UNDER THE OLD (WRONG) DOMAIN, BOTH MEASURED LIVE 2026-07-13: *** (1) opalinvest.com IS NOT AN EMPTY TARGET -- the apex serves Opal's LIVE Wix site (185.230.63.107/.171/.186), so the flip REPLACES the public website (rollback = point the apex A back at Wix, which stays up untouched; the old 72.167.58.121 host is on opalcapital.com and is NOT our rollback). (2) opalinvest.com CARRIES OPAL'S LIVE MICROSOFT 365 EMAIL (MX->outlook, SPF, selector1/selector2 _domainkey, autodiscover, DMARC) -- AT GODADDY, TOUCH ONLY THE APEX A AND www; NEVER 'clean up the old Wix records', which would kill company mail. Also: apex A TTL is ~86400s, so the TTL must be lowered 24-48h BEFORE the flip or rollback takes a day. SEPARATE + GATED (NOT a go-live task): graduating the form sender from noreply@opalinvest.dev to @opalinvest.com requires EDITING the existing SPF TXT (a SECOND SPF record is an RFC-7208 permerror that breaks M365 mail firm-wide) -- do not bundle it into the launch. HARD LEASH (unchanged): lift-and-shift, no redesign; GoDaddy records-only; harden + network-isolate the public WP surface (firm-sep -- never any data-estate IAM). ANDREW-CONFIRMED INTENT, POST-GO-LIVE ONLY: retire opalcapital.com from our process entirely (already done on our side; we own nothing there to retire).
